title: When notification's main body text is scrollable, scrollview is inset which looks weird
line: The scrollbar of a long notification popup now sits at the popup's edge instead of floating inside its margin.
explanation: The popup's body ScrollView sits inside the popup's padding like the rest of the content, so its scrollbar (with its own theme insets and separator) ended up a few pixels away from the popup border, looking inset and detached. The header and timeout bar already extend into that padding with negative layout margins. The body now does the same on the scrollbar's side while the scrollbar is shown and no icon sits next to it, so the scrollbar is flush with the popup edge like other Plasma scroll views.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: let the body scrollbar touch the popup edge

When the body text of a notification popup was long enough to scroll, its
scrollbar sat inside the popup padding, leaving an odd gap to the edge. The
body now extends into that padding while the scrollbar is shown.

BUG: 450699

patches.diff:
From b722196dec4408c2e86c6b659d356ed63e953ce2 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 03:40:29 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/notifications: let the body scrollbar touch the popup
 edge

When the body text of a notification popup was long enough to scroll, its
scrollbar sat inside the popup padding, leaving an odd gap to the edge. The
body now extends into that padding while the scrollbar is shown.

BUG: 450699
---
 applets/notifications/delegates/DelegatePopup.qml | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegatePopup.qml b/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegatePopup.qml
index bc2f8700de..ad9a418f81 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegatePopup.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/delegates/DelegatePopup.qml
@@ -133,6 +133,8 @@ BaseDelegate {
         Layout.column: delegateRoot.__firstColumn
         Layout.columnSpan: icon.visible ? 1 : 2
         Layout.maximumHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * delegateRoot.modelInterface.maximumLineCount
+        Layout.leftMargin: Layout.mirrored && scroll.PlasmaComponents3.ScrollBar.vertical.visible && !icon.visible ? -delegateRoot.modelInterface.popupLeftPadding : 0
+        Layout.rightMargin: !Layout.mirrored && scroll.PlasmaComponents3.ScrollBar.vertical.visible && !icon.visible ? -delegateRoot.modelInterface.popupRightPadding : 0
         // The body doesn't need to influence the implicit width in any way, this avoids a binding loop
         implicitWidth: -1
         implicitHeight: scroll.implicitHeight
-- 
2.53.0

Same notification: the scrollbar now reaches the popup edge.
